Embedded systems & RTL

RTL Design and FPGA Verification

Planned notes on Verilog SoC integration, simulation testbenches, waveform debugging, and timing-clean Vivado FPGA builds.

To be continued…

Planned scope

This planned series covers practical RTL integration and verification workflows on FPGA targets, including memory-mapped peripherals, custom register interfaces, self-checking testbenches in Icarus Verilog and Verilator, GTKWave debugging, and Vivado timing constraints.

Topics to cover

  • Verilog RTL and SoC wrappers
  • Memory-mapped interfaces and BRAM
  • Self-checking testbenches in Icarus Verilog and Verilator
  • Waveform inspection with GTKWave
  • Vivado synthesis, constraints, and timing closure

Related work

  • Power side-channel attack on RISC-V
